title: Publish your AI Studio site
blurb: Put your page live on a preview link, then on your own domain.

steps.title: Open AI Studio
steps.body: Click **AI Studio** in the left menu.

steps.title: Publish to a preview link
steps.body: Click **Publish**. It goes live on a preview address first so you can share and check it.

steps.title: Connect your domain
steps.body: In the publish options, connect your own domain, for example yourbusiness.co.nz. You will need access to where your domain is registered.
steps.tip: Need a hand with the domain records? Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Connect forms and bookings
steps.body: Check any form or booking section is linked to your Luubu forms and calendar so enquiries land in Contacts.
